title: Agent Mesh V2 Profile File Schema
description: Shared profile definitions imported by flow pipelines via 'imports.profiles'.

Profile.description: Reusable LLM settings. Steps reference by name; profile fields act as defaults the step can override.

backend.description: Default LLM backend for steps using this profile.

agent.description: Default agent tool(s) for steps using this profile. Can be a single string or a fallback list.

role.description: Default role text prepended to system prompt.

system_prompt.description: Default system prompt. Can be a file reference or literal text.
